HOW IT WORKS

01

Connect your help desk

Read only access to tickets, macros and your help centre.

02

Kestrel learns your voice

It studies how your best agents write, so drafts sound like you.

03

Agents stay in charge

Your team reviews each draft. In this demo, nothing is sent.

Human judgement.
Built into the loop.

  • Review sources before approving a draft.
  • Hand over when the documents do not cover the question.
  • Keep edits and final decisions with your team.
  • Discuss production data handling before connecting a help desk.

A NOTE FROM THE FOUNDERS

The answer was usually
already written down.

We spent six years answering support tickets before we wrote a line of Kestrel. The answers were almost always already written down somewhere, in a doc, a macro or a reply from last spring. Kestrel finds them, shows its working and lets your team decide.

We would rather it said nothing than said something wrong.

Ruth Adeyemi, CEO · Jonas Kraft, CTO
